assets.description: Break kitchen on the bare-brick east wall of the mill floor: deep green painted field, fitted birch-ply kitchen, brass wall light over the coffee machine, oak high table and stools, exit door and extinguisher beyond the column line.

Reception at the foot of the brick stair tower: glass doors with the landing window behind, sofa and print on the white north wall, two-height oak desk on a deep green panel, four access gates with glass screens, steel column at the left edge.

Short corridor from the south window to the lift lobby: birch-ply store room wall with door and extinguisher, phone booth, green noticeboard on the right, sun grid on the maple floor, lift and stair door in the white brick tower face under the joists and red pipe.
